title: fix(plugin-list): a held user filter does not narrow the fetch on a dataset-bound chart (objectui#10512)
body:
Fixes #10512

Clause-②: no

## What changes

objectui#10327 withholds the toolbar Filter builder and the `UserFilters` chips while a dataset-bound `chart` is on screen (`datasetChartOnScreen`), but only the controls. A group the host restored at mount (`initialFilters`), or one set on a grid before an in-list switch, still reached `ListView`'s own fetch, and so the record-count bar. This PR withholds the APPLIED user filter too, in the shape objectui#10326 gave Search (`searchTerm` derived empty beside the held `searchInput`), as the triage ruled (comment 5829668693).

- `appliedFilters` / `appliedUserFilterConditions` are derived beside the held `currentFilters` / `userFilterConditions`: empty while `datasetChartOnScreen`, the held value otherwise.
- The held state is not touched: a switch back to a view that offers the controls applies it again, and `onFilterChange` is not called for the switch.
- The view's own `schema.filter` is not the user's filter and stays in the query.
- Each held source is swapped for a module constant only when it holds something, so a switch into the dataset chart with nothing held hands the fetch effect the identities it already had and re-issues no query (the objectui#7394 class).
- ⛔ The toolbar gate (`showFilters` / `showUserFilters`) from objectui#10327 is unchanged: no diff line touches either flag.

### Readers of the user filter

Switched to the applied value:

- the fetch: `buildEffectiveFilter` in the fetch effect, and the effect's dependency list;
- the server export: `buildEffectiveFilter` in the export callback, and its dependency list (the client export writes `data`, the fetch's own answer);
- `pageResetSignature`;
- `selfQueryFilter`, with no behaviour change: its consumers (the gantt, tree and object-bound chart nodes) are views on which `datasetChartOnScreen` is false, so applied equals held there, and the dataset node carries no filter (objectui#10327). Switched so that its comment, "the SAME effective filter this component's own fetch sends", stays literally true;
- the grid empty-state `hasActiveQuery`, with no behaviour change (grid only, where applied equals held).

Left on the held state, deliberately:

- the Filter builder's `value`, and its trigger's `hasFilters` highlight and badge count: the control that shows and edits the held group, not rendered on the dataset chart;
- `UserFilters`, which keeps its own selection state and is not rendered on the dataset chart;
- the host write-back (`onFilterChange`, `onUserFilterSelectionsChange`), fired only by the controls, so the host's storage keeps the held state.

## H0, measured first (objectui `origin/main` `a506001`)

A component-level probe (not committed): the real `ListView`, an `object-chart` stand-in that records the node it is handed, a dataset-bound `chart` block, and `initialFilters` restoring `status equals open` over three rows. Readings on the base:

- the chart node was the dataset shape (`dataset: task_ds`, no `filter` key);
- `ListView`'s fetch ran, 1 call, with `$filter` = `["status","=","open"]`;
- the record-count bar rendered and read `1 record` (3 rows unnarrowed);
- neither the Filter builder nor the chips were on screen.

The fetch runs AND the count bar draws, so the narrowing is user-visible and the fix lands. ⛔ Not rendered in a browser: the count bar is `ListView`'s own DOM, independent of the chart renderer.

## Pins

`ListView.datasetChartAppliedFilter-10512.test.tsx` in `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__`, 6 cases. Each asserts the query the data source receives (the fake answers from the fields its `$filter` names, so the count bar reads a different number for a narrowed query):

1. CONTROL: on a grid, a restored group narrows the fetch, and the count bar reads `1 record`.
2. CONTROL: on a chart bound to the list object, a restored group still narrows the fetch.
3. On a dataset-bound chart the fetch runs and the count bar draws, and a restored group narrows neither: no `$filter` in any call, the bar reads `3 records`, `onFilterChange` not called.
4. The view's own `filter` stays in the query on the dataset chart, alone: every call's `$filter` equals the base filter, the bar reads `2 records`.
5. A group restored on a grid plus a chip toggled there stop narrowing the fetch on a switch to the dataset chart, and the group applies again back on the grid; the builder badge still reads 1 and `onFilterChange` is never called.
6. CONTROL (objectui#7394): with nothing held, the switch to the dataset chart re-issues no query.

### Reverse verification (from the committed fix)

`ListView.tsx` checked out at the base `a506001` (on-disk blob `03798ad` equal to the base blob; 0 occurrences of `appliedFilters` on disk), the pin run, then restored with `git checkout HEAD --` under a trap (restored blob `d86a5db` equal to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes):

- base leg: exit 1, `Tests  3 failed | 3 passed (6)`; red are cases 3, 4 and 5, green are the three controls;
- fix leg: exit 0, `Tests  6 passed (6)`.

### Ablation (the objectui#7394 control can fail)

Predicted before running: an unconditional swap of the Filter group turns case 6 red and nothing else. Run through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor `datasetChartOnScreen && currentFilters.conditions && currentFilters.conditions.length > 0`, 1 hit, anchor count 1 to 0, blob `d86a5db` to `d364171`): exit 1, `Tests  1 failed | 5 passed (6)`, the failed case is case 6. Restored: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. Observed direction matches the prediction.

## Verification (final head `ad119b4`, after merging `origin/main` `f5178a2`)

- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check-type-check-coverage.mjs`, `check-lint-coverage.mjs`: each exit 0.

`check:changeset-claims` names 7 pending changesets that mention `ListView.tsx` (`7070-no-invented-gantt-date-fields`, `7499-gantt-non-axis-floors-omitted`, `7773-kanban-adapter-groupfield-write`, `7780-object-kanban-record-source`, `8990-object-kanban-groupby-optional`, `list-user-actions-collision-5398`, `listview-comment-pair-4559`). Each paragraph was read; none is about how the user filter is applied, and none is made false by this diff.

## Changeset

`.changeset/10512-dataset-chart-applied-filter.md`, `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-list`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Chip state across an in-list switch (pre-existing, not changed here).** Measured on the base `a506001` with the same probe harness: toggle a `UserFilters` chip ON on a grid, switch to the dataset chart, switch back. The chip renders OFF again (its button carries the outline variant), while `ListView`'s held `userFilterConditions` still sends `["priority","!=",null]` and the count bar reads `2 records`. `UserFilters` keeps its selection in its own state, and the objectui#10327 gate unmounts it on the dataset chart. This PR leaves the grid leg exactly as it was (applied equals held there); the pin deliberately does not assert the chip's return. Reported to the seat as a separate finding. Dropdown and tab chips were not measured.
- **An unfinished builder row.** The swap keys on the held group's row count, not on its compiled filter (compiling at render could throw a `FilterOperatorError`). A held group whose every row is unfinished therefore still swaps on a switch into the dataset chart, and that one switch re-issues a query equal to the one before it.

The session that implemented this: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy` (domain:ui seat 5 dispatch).
